name: libelf
description: ELF object file access library, part of the Elfutils package.
build: cd elfutils-0.193 && make -C lib $MAKEOPTS && make -C libelf $MAKEOPTS
install: cd elfutils-0.193 && make -C libelf DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" install
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
